name: pi-outpost-posters
description: Claude composes posters, worksheets and slides; you retouch them in the conversation — correct a text, move a pictogram, change a colour — and export them to Word or PowerPoint.
long_description: Ask Claude for a poster: it is written as a printable page in the folder you choose, and shown in an editor in the conversation. Double-click a text to correct it, drag an element to move it, change colours and sizes in the Style panel, then Save: Claude reads your version before its next change. Word gives an A4 page to print, PowerPoint a slide to show; both carry the poster as a picture, kept beside it in your folder. Every version is kept in a hidden folder beside the poster. No account, no network.
